name: ab_perfect_mul_abundant_any
statement: (n k : ℕ) (hn : Nat.Perfect n) : Nat.Abundant (k * n)
closed: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (hn : Nat.Perfect n), Nat.Abundant (k * n)
informal: Task 3(a) literally, k any natural number (including 0). FALSE (k = 1, k = 0).
original: If n is perfect, then kn is abundant for any k ∈ N.
